name: story-landing
title: Story landing
description: A product landing page told as a short manga, made only with mangacn, for an invented habit app: a top bar, an opening MagazineCover (masthead band, issue box, cover lines around drawn art) beside a lettering headline, a shout Button and a contents page that lists the chapters like the first page of a volume; then four sections titled with ChapterTitle (big number, vertical text): a Yonkoma strip on the page model that explains the product in four beats (a column on phones, four in a row from 40rem; captions and an Sfx put on the panels with Place), a guide character who talks the reader through it in a DialogueBox, reader quotes in SpeechBubbles, and a closing call to action. Jumping to a chapter plays a stepped SceneTransition (four ink panels, a "Meanwhile…" caption), then focus moves to the section; starting plays an ink wipe and reveals a finished state with an Sfx. Reduced motion: instant. Container queries widen it; links never navigate; nothing is posted. Works in light, dark, any accent, both reading orders and at phone width.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/story-landing". The root fills its container and follows the page (no inner scroll). The chapter transition covers the viewport (scope "screen"). The art is drawn inline in the file: replace it with your own drawings.

meta.tagline: A product page told as a manga: cover, four-panel strip, a guide, chapters.
